dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the visible posterior tip.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light gray to off-white across the primary dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-density distribution of irregular, dark-pixel clusters concentrated on the posterior half of the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the relatively clear anterior region and the heavily mottled posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible dark circular blowhole aperture on the anterior dorsal plane.
